ITEM 2 CONFIRMED VERBATIM — plus an IMPLEMENTATION CONSTRAINT the plan does not state, which decides
how the fix has to be shaped. Verified at df41edcf25.

THE VACUITY IS EXACTLY AS DESCRIBED. In test_dc_transport_pagination_heldout.py,
test_the_structural_guard_fires_on_a_synthetic_unpaginated_caller re-implements the AST walk INLINE
(its own ast.parse, its own isinstance(ast.Call)/isinstance(ast.Attribute) checks, its own
attr == 'search_issues' test, its own maxResults/max_results keyword check) rather than calling the
predicate the real guard uses. Its docstring says 'TEETH for the guard itself. A structural test that
cannot fail is decoration' — and it is decoration: the only way it can fail is if the ast module
itself breaks. The real predicate could regress to 'return []' and this cell stays green while
test_no_search_issues_call_relies_on_the_default_page_size silently stops guarding anything.

THE CONSTRAINT — AND IT IS WHY 'JUST CALL THE HELPER' IS NOT A ONE-LINE FIX.
_search_issues_calls_taking_the_default() (same file, ~line 145) takes NO PARAMETERS and hardcodes
its input: 'tree = ast.parse(_TRANSPORT_SRC.read_text())'. So the teeth test CANNOT point at it as
written — there is no seam to feed a synthetic file through. Note also it is a TEST-MODULE helper,
not a src/ helper, so 'the production helper' in the plan means 'the predicate the production guard
consumes', which is this function.

THE SHAPE THAT ACTUALLY GIVES IT TEETH: give the helper an optional source parameter, e.g.

    def _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default(src: str | None = None) -> list[str]:
        tree = ast.parse(src if src is not None else _TRANSPORT_SRC.read_text())

Then the real guard keeps calling it with NO argument (unchanged behaviour, and its own assertion is
untouched), while the teeth test calls it WITH the synthetic unpaginated source. That is what makes
the mutation check in this ticket's AC meaningful: breaking the predicate — e.g. dropping the
'max_results' alternative from the keyword set, or making offenders always empty — must turn the
TEETH test red, which is impossible today.

WHAT NOT TO DO, because both preserve the defect while looking like a fix:
 * Do not add a SECOND standalone predicate for the synthetic case. That reproduces the duplication
   that caused the vacuity, and the two copies can then drift — which is the same defect class as
   sibling ticket bd9e-0740-1b47-47f8 in this very epic.
 * Do not settle for asserting the helper merely RUNS on the synthetic input. The assertion must be
   that it REPORTS the offender, since 'returns a list' is satisfied by 'return []'.

MUTATION-CHECK NOTE: mutate the PREDICATE, not the synthetic fixture. Mutating the fixture only
proves the fixture is unpaginated, which nobody doubts.
